Valuation and view: Reiterate BUY We expect BFL to benefit from accelerating demand for branded snacks, shifting consumer preferences, and increasing traction within modern trade and ecommerce channels.
We trim our earnings and reiterate our BUY rating with a DCF-based TP of INR640 (based on an implied P/E of 50x on FY28E).
watch: Commodity and cost pressure weigh on margins Gross margin contracted 60bp YoY to 34.4% due to inflation in key commodities, but gross profit still grew 11.2% YoY to INR3,231m.
Distribution expansion, marketing investments, and THF's strong growth outlook remain key drivers of medium-term growth.
